purpose: Upload-ready image batch for Hawaiʻi Archive Revival mixed historical feed.
notes: This batch mixes source-faithful image sets and reconstructed-only support images.
Original archival source images are included where available in this workspace, especially for Kaulia and the wide ʻIolani Palace panorama.
For reconstructed-only items, the source-original lane is still pending and should be researched/attached in a later batch when available.
Use relationship labels honestly: exact, near, or context.
